At T6, although the entire board and officer tier were replaced same-day, the broader non-officer workforce (operations-running people) were bridged forward via one-year compensation/benefits-parity, severance, service-credit and honored-labor-agreement commitments in the Purchase Agreement, so the processes and the people who run them were structurally aligned at closing (gap_56=0). Because neither gap was coded, gap_mitigated is NA. T3 coded swap because control moved into a Purchaser vehicle with Patheon N.V. slated for dissolution/liquidation and delisting.
